subject: Idea for Camille
body:
Hi,

I came across Camille and spent some time looking through the restaurant. What stood out most was the Chef's Counter — ten courses, no walk-ins, and a reservation-only format that signals the meal is designed to be an event from the start.

From what I saw, Camille already reads as distinct, but I think the content could lean even more into the intimacy of the counter and the pacing between courses — the way the room feels when you are that close to the kitchen — so the viewer understands this is not a standard dinner.

I create luxury travel UGC built around that kind of experience-led storytelling. The concept I had for Camille would move from arrival at the counter through the final course, capturing the progression and the atmosphere that make the experience feel as considered as the menu itself.

Happy to send over the full angle I had in mind for Camille.

Best,
Malachi
